clauses.title: The packaged helper boundary is structural with byte smoke alarms
clauses.section: ## CL-D37 — Bounded helper surface is structural
requires: no commit, push, merge, reply, approval, or thread-resolution CLI operation
no durable workflow state or scheduling
no persistent state written outside a validated external run root
#292 later allowed the helpers one wait
another deliberate evasion is outside what it claims, as before #292
CL-D57 and CL-D72 read them through this record
trimming code merely to silence the alarm remains the recorded anti-pattern, not compliance

clauses.title: The snapshot's read retries hold the one wait the helpers may hold
requires: function delay(ms) { return new Promise((resolve) => { setTimeout(resolve, ms); }); }
The backoff is the one wait CL-D37 allows the helpers.

clauses.title: The structural test exempts the snapshot backoff's pinned block alone
requires: a shadowed global or another deliberate evasion is outside what it claims
the snapshot backoff is used outside its pinned site
